subject: lavaan.survey paper out in Journal of Statistical Software

messages.author: 949f9be37ba0e6cd
messages.subject: lavaan.survey paper out in Journal of Statistical Software
parts:
Dear all,


The paper on lavaan.survey, a package to do SEM with complex survey data (or just data with weights, clusters, and strata) is now out in today's issue of the Journal of Statistical Software. See here

   http://www.jstatsoft.org/v57/i01

for the paper (open access like all of JSS) and examples. The same examples are also included in the package (see data sets).

The examples include:
  • Full SEM model with latent variables using PISA data and its replicate weights (model from Ferla et al 2009)
  • CFA using European Social Survey data accounting for the UK's multistage sampling design (model from Roosma et al 2012)
  • A quasi-simplex model using LISS panel data demonstrating multiple imputation (made up by me but motivated by the need to estimate reliability of survey questions in complex survey panel data, e.g. Alwin 2007)
  • A path model of species diversity and oxygen productivity measured in PVC elbows nested within Californian streams, thanks to our very own Jarrett Byrnes' GitHub repository of lavaan analyses https://github.com/jebyrnes/Ecological-SEMs-in-lavaan (original model by Cardinale et al 2009).
Another example using multiple group modeling of ESS data is included in an upcoming (1 April) blog post created by Anthony D'Amico for his trove of R survey analyses: http://www.asdfree.com/ .

Enjoy!


Daniel

@DanielOberski
